feedback: Onboarding took our team 3 days and still half the features don't work. Worst SaaS experience ever.
The automated performance review workflow saved our HR team literally 40 hours this cycle.
SSO integration with Azure AD keeps breaking. Our whole team gets locked out every few weeks.
The org chart visualization is beautiful and actually useful for understanding reporting structures.
Payroll module calculated incorrect deductions for 12 employees. Created a nightmare at month end.
Employee self-service portal has reduced HR queries by 60%. Massive time saver.
Leave balance calculations are completely wrong after the recent update. Shows negative leave for some employees.
The mobile app for employees is very limited. Can't approve leave requests from phone.
Custom report builder is incredibly powerful. Built a headcount analysis in minutes that used to take days.
Bulk employee import via CSV fails silently — no error message, just doesn't import.
The compliance alerts for policy renewals and certifications are a lifesaver. Nothing slips through.
Data export takes forever. Exporting 500 employee records takes 20 minutes and often times out.
UI is completely non-intuitive. Our HR team needed a full week of training just for basic tasks.
The Slack integration for announcements and leave approvals is seamless.
Two-factor authentication is mandatory but the authenticator app support is broken for Android users.
Recruitment pipeline view is excellent. Our hiring manager can see every candidate's status at a glance.
The audit trail logs are incomplete — major changes aren't being recorded. Compliance risk.
Calendar sync with Google Calendar and Outlook is broken. Meetings are showing at wrong times.
Employee survey module with built-in analytics is phenomenal. First time we've had actionable data.
Support tickets take 5-7 business days to get a response. Unacceptable for enterprise software.
API documentation is outdated. Endpoints described in the docs return 404 errors.
The training and certification tracking module has transformed our L&D compliance process.
System is down for maintenance every Sunday during business hours for us (different timezone). Major issue.
Salary revision workflow is perfect. Approvals, notifications, and payroll sync all work as expected.
Offboarding checklist feature is great but doesn't automatically revoke software access. Security gap.
The analytics dashboard is slow to load. Charts take 30+ seconds to render for companies > 1000 employees.
Cannot assign custom roles with specific permissions. Only 3 pre-set roles available.
The goal-setting OKR module has increased visibility across teams. Very positive culture impact.
Payslip generation fails for employees with variable pay components. Critical bug.
Multi-currency payroll for our global team works flawlessly. The exchange rate handling is accurate.
The probation review reminder system is excellent — never miss a review now.
System doesn't support Indian statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT) properly. Lots of manual workarounds.
Department-wise headcount reports have inconsistent numbers. Same report run twice gives different results.
The 360-degree feedback module is transforming how we do performance conversations.
Employee data is not encrypted at rest based on our security audit. Huge compliance concern.
Cannot bulk-update employee designations after a restructuring. Have to change one by one.
The exit interview digitization feature has helped us identify why our top talent was leaving.
Session unexpectedly logs out during payroll processing. Losing unsaved data is a critical workflow issue.
New employee welcome email templates are fully customizable — great first impression feature.
Document management module has no version control. Overwriting policies is irreversible.
The succession planning module has added real strategic value for our leadership team.
GDPR-compliant data deletion requests take over 30 days to process. That's not compliant.
Benefits enrollment portal is confusing and employees keep enrolling in wrong plans.
Automated birthday and work anniversary notifications have improved team morale significantly.
The mobile app crashes on iPads. Our field managers use iPads exclusively.
Time and attendance tracking integration with our biometric devices is flawless.
Cannot generate an employee census report without contacting support. Should be self-service.
The implementation team was exceptional — held our hand through every step of the setup.
Shift scheduling module doesn't account for employees' declared availability preferences.
Best HR platform we've used in 10 years. The ROI was visible within the first quarter.
